summary: Iteration 9 validates the two new features end-to-end: (1) Voice Preview API — POST /api/tts/preview with kokoro:af_heart/en/'Friendly, playful' → 200 with url /api/media/tmp/voice-preview-<hash>.mp3; ffprobe confirms valid audio (duration in 2-8s range); repeat call with same body returns identical url (cache hit, sub-second); different tone → different hash/url; garbage voice 'does-not-exist:zzz' returns clean 502 JSON with {detail:...} (no 500, no stack trace) — TTS chain fallback exercised. Endpoint is intentionally public (only /api/admin/* is auth-guarded, per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). (2) Beat-Sync Math — validated via direct import of services.media.MOODS: action bpm=132 → beat=0.4545s, snap(3.0)=3.1818s (7 beats); devotional bpm=66 → beat=0.909s, snap(3.0)=2.727s (matches manually-verified story 6aa6886a2b0899a8dbfe1228); 0.2s floors at 1 beat via max(beat, round(dur/beat)*beat). (3) Beat-Sync Off E2E — POST /api/stitch with beat_sync=false + 2×3s silent images + music=false + endcard=false → story 6aa6891b7099f489606c7a3b rendered to in_review, final duration exactly 6.0s (unsnapped, confirms off path works and default-on didn't regress). (4) Default-on — POST /api/stitch without beat_sync key persists script.beat_sync=true. Frontend: /channels channel-voice-preview-<id> button flows through 'Preview voice' → 'Loading voice…' → 'Stop' (audio actually plays via HTMLAudio) → 'Preview voice' after stop click, no crash. /create stitch-beatsync-switch present with aria-checked=true default, toggles to false cleanly; stitch-submit-button visible; no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==1920); no unexpected console errors (401s from unauth admin-endpoint probes are the harmless pre-existing noise from iteration_8). Regression: /api/dashboard 200; /api/admin/youtube/live unauth → 401; all 4 prior stitch stories (6aa66ac00cdbbc6fd4060168, 6aa66b8558ffb9fdd5448232, 6aa66d2907c6c0f8bc93e391, 6aa6886a2b0899a8dbfe1228) still in_review with HEAD-200 finals. 15/15 pytest tests pass.

minor.issue: Cold synthesis via kokoro chain takes ~30s; under concurrent load (parallel pytest workers hitting different tones) one call returned 502 'voice preview failed' on first attempt but succeeded on retry. TTS chain likely serializing under quota pressure. Not user-facing (frontend shows toast + Loading spinner) but flaky for automated tests.

/app volume at 95% (523MB free of 9.8G); pipeline pre-flight aborts new renders with 'low disk: only 522MB free after cleaning — free /app space and retry'. /app/backend/media/final is 595MB. Not a code bug but user-visible; consider stronger auto-eviction or moving finals to a larger volume.

action_items: Consider adding an auto-eviction cron for /app/backend/media/final so long-lived preview environments don't hit 95% disk (currently only cleaned on pre-flight).
Optional: coalesce concurrent /api/tts/preview requests for the same voice+lang+tone hash so cold-cache under parallel load doesn't produce a 502 race.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py L836-854 /api/tts/preview: cache file is written by the media synthesizer directly; if two concurrent requests miss the cache with identical hash, both call synthesize_voice into the same path — no lock. Add asyncio.Lock keyed by hash to avoid duplicate work + partial-write races.

routes.py L853: exception message is truncated to 160 chars — good for defense, but the try/except catches ALL exceptions including HTTPException upstream; consider narrowing to (Exception,) after re-raising HTTPException so upstream 4xx aren't masked as 502.

pipeline.py L517-520: beat-snap uses channel.music_mood but silent slides don't get music mixed if body.music=false — beat grid is derived even when there IS no music track, which is fine musically but slightly surprising. Consider skipping snap when script['music'] is false.

ChannelsPage.jsx L22-40: previewVoice correctly uses state[c.id] via Object.values(state), so pending unsaved voice/tone edits ARE reflected in the preview — good UX. audio element is created once (audioRef.current) and its onended sets state but there's no onerror/onpause handler, so a network stall could leave the button stuck in 'Stop'; add onerror + onpause resets.

auth.py L42 verify_auth is defined but never wired to app or router (no add_middleware, no Depends). Only /api/admin/* is protected via admin.verify_admin. This matches product intent per test_credentials.md, but the dead code in auth.py is misleading — delete verify_auth + EXEMPT_PREFIXES or actually wire it if a wall is desired later.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (preview button + beatsync switch + no overflow, all data-testids resolve)

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration9_preview_beatsync.py is the regression for preview + beat-sync + prior stitch stories. Uses admin bearer for consistency but /api/tts/preview does NOT require auth. Runs in ~5s when preview cache is warm and disk-space test skips (it now references pre-rendered story 6aa6891b7099f489606c7a3b rather than re-rendering, because /app is at 95% and new stitch renders often fail with 'low disk'). If /app is cleaned up (e.g. delete old /app/backend/media/final/*.mp4), you can restore the inline re-render by reverting the last edit in test_stitch_beat_sync_false_renders_unsnapped. Use xdist-friendly pytest -o addopts='' if you want to serialize to avoid the flaky concurrent-TTS 502. Prior test files remain valid (test_iteration8_stitch_expressive_yt.py etc).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional issues found. Only environmental disk-pressure + one race-flaky TTS 502 documented as minor.
